Initial release of Interior Designer Video skill to help interior designers showcase their work through engaging videos.

- Guides users to create different types of videos: portfolio, project feature, process walkthroughs, and before/after transformations.
- Collects key project and service details to customize each video.
- Generates concise 60–90 second scripts for effective storytelling.
- Suggests relevant b-roll and visual elements to highlight design skills and client collaboration.
- Supports various interior design niches and service models.
